items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Henry Martin is made by the Interviewer ('I guess Henry Martin played snare drum'), and the Interviewee does not confirm or deny this, nor does the Interviewee mention Henry Martin in their own turns.

ctx.x: Man, I'll laugh like that. Johnny went back and I was always hanging out. Then we went back to Miss Martin and said, what's the matter with you? He said, Dan Lewis, I said, Dan Lewis hit him in the eye.
